spec.description: The unmodified spec passed into the setup process.

errors.description: Any errors that occurred during the setup process.

criticalFunctions.description:
Any functions that are considered critical to a setup process. For example,
{@link IdsDeploymentUtil#deployIdsControlTag} while running {@link IdsDeploymentUtil#setUpDevCluster}.

registerDevelopmentPodInMarketplace.description: Whether or not a {@link Pod} was successfully created in Marketplace describing the IDS control tag.

registerPmUserInMarketplace.description:
Whether or not a {@link User} was created to represent the IDS control tag in Marketplace.
This {@link User} will be used as both the PackageManager and Marketplace admin for the IDS control tag.

registerPlatformOrganizationInMarketplac.description: Whether or not a {@link PlatformOrganization} was created to represent the IDS control tag in Marketplace.

title: {@link IdsSetupResult} type describing the registration of an IDS control tag in Marketplace (repository.c3-e.com).
name: IdsMarketplaceRegistrationResult
